chronology: A private browser prototype predates the updated project instructions. The specification and additional unit-tested model work are recorded now; prior test history is preserved without relabelling it.

observed: The India list contains Not Applicable and 36 state or territory names in a stable order
A Raj query offers Rajasthan; arrows change the highlighted choice
Enter and Tab accept Rajasthan and advance to Pincode
Enter and Tab accepting Not Applicable advance to Country
Escape clears a nonempty search; the next Escape closes suggestions and requests company exit without restoring the opening State
Cancelling that exit retains a blank State and reopens suggestions; an accepted nondefault draft State is not restored
Down at the last state keeps that state highlighted

escapeEvidence.scope: Isolated unsaved creation; default and explicitly accepted nondefault draft State. The saved-company case is an original Bookr compatibility regression, not a separate native observation.

country.effect: Existing editable text; suggestions are enabled only for India

keyboard.Enter or Tab: Use the selected suggestion; a substantive state and country advance to Pincode, otherwise Country
keyboard.ArrowUp or ArrowDown: Move the highlight without changing the input; clamp at the list boundary
keyboard.Escape with text: Clear the search and keep the suggestions available
keyboard.Escape without text: Close suggestions and delegate the same key to existing company exit/dirty confirmation. Keep the blank draft; No or dialog Escape cancels exit without restoring the old value
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Close suggestions and preserve normal backward focus
keyboard.Ctrl+A: Commit the chosen value and invoke the existing company save once

compatibility: Retain existing unknown saved state strings
Retain unmatched entered text through the existing free-text contract; this does not create a geographic master
Leaving the field without choosing a suggestion must not silently replace entered text
Optional blank text remains compatible with existing company storage
Non-India companies retain existing text entry
validation: No new geographic, postal, tax or country-validation rules
defaults: Keep existing company defaults; do not infer country-dependent accounting defaults
accountingEffect: None. Dates, currency, ledgers, vouchers, postings, bill allocations and outstanding balances remain unchanged.
implementation: Original reusable input-backed suggestion component with a separately tested pure behavior model

pureModel.scope: Filtering, selection, bounded movement, accepted-value focus and observed Escape action projection.
pureModel.buildTextChoices: Return ordered copied rows and a preferred index from catalog, pinned values, opening text and optional query; preserve unknown opening text and offer unmatched entered text explicitly.
pureModel.moveHighlight: Clamp movement at the first and last row; no selection for an empty list.
pureModel.chooseDraftValue: Explicit acceptance uses the chosen row; whole-form acceptance preserves optional blank text; a closed list preserves raw text.
pureModel.nextCompanyAddressField: A substantive state and country advance to Pincode; otherwise Country.
pureModel.escapeTextChoice: A closed list delegates; an open list with text clears; an open empty list closes and delegates exit. Never return or restore the opening value.
pureModel.boundary: Observed creation cancellation is integrated with Bookr's existing original confirmation and saved-company compatibility; no new company configuration or accounting rule.

verification.unitFirst: New model tests must fail before model implementation; this is new work rather than retroactive prototype history
verification.browser: Save/reopen, keyboard entry, cancellation, unknown text, company isolation, one save, and desktop/320/390 layout
verification.execution: Unit then browser serially, owned disposable fictional databases only
verification.previewAudit: Read-only port 4780; no access or tests against protected port 4315
verification.moneyRegression: The fictional 1000 sale and 400 receipt retain 600 outstanding

browserCommands.execution: Complete chain after units on frozen source

verificationResult.actualSource: Twenty suggestion/Escape units and fifteen browser groups passed after exact-source promotion
verificationResult.screenshots: Eight fixture screenshots and three read-only preview screenshots bind the intended view and saved API state; desktop and 320/390 layouts reviewed
verificationResult.previewAudit: Existing preview process and all saved rows retained; no attempted writes or page errors
verificationResult.accounting: Exact fictional financial records and 60000-paise outstanding retained
verificationResult.additionalRegression: Shift+ArrowUp/Down text selection was reproduced against a plain input before the modifier guard was added

userDecision: Continue headlessly. The isolated creation study resolved empty-search Escape. Company alteration uses the same original Bookr component and existing discard confirmation, covered by compatibility tests.
